metadata.title: Scalar curvature bounds and rigidity of Ricci shrinkers
metadata.abstract: We prove that a complete noncompact gradient shrinking Ricci soliton of dimension at least two is a finite quotient of an Einstein cylinder if its scalar curvature is bounded below by the cylindrical value. The corresponding pointwise strict bound implies compactness. We also establish one-endedness criteria using curvature information at critical points of the potential, including degenerate ones, and obtain sharp one-endedness and rigidity results under global Ricci norm bounds.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究完备梯度收缩 Ricci 孤子的标量曲率下界、端结构及圆柱刚性。
techniques: 标量曲率与 Ricci 范数控制
analysis.breakthrough: 在 Ric+Hess f=g/2 归一化下，非紧流形若 R≥(n−1)/2，则 R 恒等于该值，再由已有常标量曲率刚性推出紧 Einstein 因子与直线的有限商。处处 R>(n−1)/2 即推出紧性，无需统一正间隙。
analysis.limitations: 端结构另有独立条件。仅临界集上 Ric≥0 且 R<(n−1)/2 可推单端；全局 |Ric|²≤(n−1)/4 时，多端情形才强制全局圆柱直积。补读主定理与路线，未独立核验全证。
